import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_geomrecur_b(i_n)
    u_stack = Vector{Float64}(undef, div(i_n - 2, 1) + 1)
    return u_stack
end

function geomrecur_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, c, cb, i_n, u_stack)
    for i_seq_x = 2:i_n
        u_stack[(i_seq_x - 2) + 1] = u[i_seq_x]
        u[i_seq_x] = c * u[i_seq_x - 1]
    end
    for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
        ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:2
        u[i_seq_x] = u_stack[(i_seq_x - 2) + 1]
        cb = cb + u[i_seq_x - 1] * ub[i_seq_x]
        ub[i_seq_x - 1] = ub[i_seq_x - 1] + c * ub[i_seq_x]
        ub[i_seq_x] = 0.0
    end
    return cb
end

function initstacks_geomrecur_b_cuda(i_n)
    u_stack = CuArray{Float64}(undef, div(i_n - 2, 1) + 1)
    return u_stack
end

function geomrecur_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, c, cb, i_n, u_stack)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    for i_seq_x = 2:i_n
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                u_stack[(i_seq_x - 2) + 1] = u[i_seq_x]
                u[i_seq_x] = c * u[i_seq_x - 1]
            end
    end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_geomrecur_b_1!(i_n, loss, u)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_geomrecur_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:2
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                u[i_seq_x] = u_stack[(i_seq_x - 2) + 1]
                cb = cb + u[i_seq_x - 1] * ub[i_seq_x]
                ub[i_seq_x - 1] = ub[i_seq_x - 1] + c * ub[i_seq_x]
                ub[i_seq_x] = 0.0
            end
    end
    return cb
end

function cuda_kernel_geomrecur_b_1!(i_n, loss, u)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_geomrecur_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 2
__base_loss = Float64[-0.1619081472156922, 0.5779372832369823, 0.2767823629164127, -2.6691543948917382]
__base_u = Float64[0.13305912666891237, 1.6605627035134871, 0.3106320384515943, 0.8340121727455739]
__base_c = -0.6262474447902894
__seed_c = [0.8053550126882821, 0.8927444177461354]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-0.2743339787082948, 1.0377651806928443, -1.1630932499953834, 0.771374491148381], Float64[0.49583937834481506, 0.5530462260300283, 0.5481267478868743, -1.5747413168104878]]
__seed_u = [Float64[0.8769228765558715, -1.0546585638713057, -0.767978147510293, -0.783456026507983], Float64[0.5788591254256895, 0.8428570004800946, -0.811233623091368, 0.1677400003451036]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:2
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  c_val_cpu = __base_c; c_sh_cpu = __seed_c[__trial]
  c_val_gpu = __base_c; c_sh_gpu = __seed_c[__trial]
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_geomrecur_b, Any[i_n])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_geomrecur_b_cuda, Any[i_n])
  ret_cpu = geomrecur_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, c_val_cpu, c_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = geomrecur_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, c_val_gpu, c_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = (ret_cpu,)
  ret_gpu_t = (ret_gpu,)
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[1], ret_gpu_t[1]))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
